findings.title: Boolean-based blind SQL injection in product search
findings.description: The `q` parameter of the product search is concatenated into a SQL query, allowing boolean-based blind injection that exfiltrates the users table.
findings.remediation: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements for all database access.
findings.evidence_explanation: The two payloads returned different result sets, confirming injection, then the users table was enumerated character by character.
